description.value: The study examined physiological, facial-behavioral, and subjective sadness reactivity in three frontotemporal dementia subtypes and healthy controls, and investigated associated neural correlates using whole-brain voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: The present study examined physiological, behavioral and subjective aspects of sadness reactivity in patients with three clinical subtypes of FTD and examined areas of neurodegeneration associated with diminished responding for each aspect.

value: we hypothesized that each FTD subtype would show impairments in all three aspects of sadness reactivity compared to controls.
